title: Nausea-Friendly Pregnancy Meals: Easy to Eat and Nutritious
excerpt: Split meals into smaller ones, eaten evenly through the day. Gentler textures, and nutrient-dense snacks when morning sickness makes eating hard.
content:
## Introduction
When pregnant, eating becomes more important than ever. However, many women experience severe morning sickness, making eating a challenge. In this article, we will explore nausea-friendly pregnancy meals that are easy to eat and still cover key nutrients.

## Nutrient Analysis
According to the World Health Organization (WHO), pregnant women need to be provided with adequate nutrients to ensure health for both mother and baby. However, when experiencing severe morning sickness, eating becomes difficult, and pregnant women need to choose foods that are easy to digest and rich in nutrients.

Some essential nutrients for pregnant women include:
* Iron: helps prevent anemia and ensures health for both mother and baby
* Folate: helps prevent birth defects and ensures health for both mother and baby
* Calcium: helps build bones and teeth for the baby
* Protein: helps build and repair body tissues

## Nausea-Friendly Meals
Here are some suggestions for nausea-friendly meals that are easy to eat and still cover key nutrients:
* Eat small and frequent meals: instead of eating three meals a day, pregnant women can divide their meals into 4-6 smaller meals
* Choose gentle textures: such as porridge, soup, or cooked foods
* Nutrient-dense snacks: such as fruits, vegetables, or nuts

Some specific foods that pregnant women can try include:
* Chicken porridge
* Vegetable soup
* Fresh fruits
* Steamed vegetables
* Nuts like almonds or cashews

## Practical Tips
Here are some practical tips to help pregnant women eat easily and still get enough nutrients when experiencing severe morning sickness:
* Drink plenty of water: helps prevent dehydration and ensures health for both mother and baby
* Avoid heavy or hard-to-digest foods: such as fatty or spicy foods
* Choose easy-to-eat foods: such as cooked foods or soft fruits

## When to Seek Help
If pregnant women experience severe morning sickness and have difficulty eating, they should seek help from their doctor or a registered dietitian. They can help pregnant women develop a suitable meal plan and ensure health for both mother and baby.

* [Our website](/planner) provides information and tools to help pregnant women develop a suitable meal plan
* [The World Health Organization (WHO)](https://www.who.int/) provides information and guidelines on nutrition for pregnant women

## Conclusion
Nausea-friendly pregnancy meals are an important issue for pregnant women. With these suggestions and practical tips, pregnant women can eat easily and still get enough nutrients when experiencing severe morning sickness. Remember that eating becomes more important than ever when pregnant, and pregnant women need to be provided with adequate nutrients to ensure health for both mother and baby.
